question: Within the same fixed Japanese regional frame, does the already validated occurrence-conditioned environmental-support representation recover later novel occurrence clusters better than direct nearest-known distance or deterministic spatial balance?

shared_historical_evidence.reason: Keep the local-discovery comparison on one public, spatially interpretable historical evidence set rather than allowing methods to see different occurrence rows.

environmental_support.candidate_surface_rule: same frozen deterministic 800-point regional land-surface semantics used by the validated Japan core
environmental_support.prototype_thinning_rule: reuse acsp.taxon_patches validated thinning semantics to at most 32 complete unique environmental prototypes; no temporal-outcome-driven tuning

nearest_known.candidate_distance: minimum haversine distance from each regional candidate-surface point to any shared strict historical occurrence coordinate
nearest_known.selection_rule: exclude candidate points <=0.5 km from every historical coordinate, then take the k smallest remaining distances; ties break by stable SHA-256 key of pair_id and 8-decimal latitude/longitude
nearest_known.selection_count: exactly k, where k is environmental-support candidate_patch_count; if fewer than k eligible points remain, the declared pair is retained as a zero comparative failure

spatial_balance.candidate_pool: same regional candidate surface as environmental support
spatial_balance.selection_rule: start at the candidate with minimum stable SHA-256 key of pair_id and 8-decimal latitude/longitude; iteratively add the point maximizing its minimum haversine distance to already selected points; ties break by the same stable key
spatial_balance.selection_count: exactly k, where k is environmental-support candidate_patch_count; no environmental or outcome values enter the selection

random.selection_count: exactly k from the same regional candidate surface without replacement

outcome.recovery_rule: a novel recent cluster is recovered when any selected representative/candidate point lies within the declared recovery radius of any member coordinate in that cluster

failure_semantics.pair_generation_or_comparator_failure: retain pair with zero recovery for all compared methods and zero method differences; do not replace the taxon-region pair
failure_semantics.no_novel_recent_cluster: retain pair as temporally evaluable but primary method differences are zero because no novel recovery target exists
failure_semantics.provider_failure: retain pair as zero comparative failure; no provider or data-source substitution

decision_rule.primary: compare pair-level environmental-support minus nearest-known and environmental-support minus spatial-balance at 10 km over all 96 declared pairs with frozen zero-failure semantics
decision_rule.secondary: report environmental-support minus random and the same comparisons at 2 and 5 km descriptively only
decision_rule.development_success_requires: positive overall mean difference against both nearest-known and spatial-balance at 10 km, with positive mean environmental-minus-baseline direction in both plant and animal groups for both baselines; this may nominate a method but cannot confirm it
decision_rule.if_success: freeze nominated method unchanged and sample a new disjoint public confirmation cohort before any external local-discovery claim
decision_rule.if_fail: do not tune radii, precision, support fraction, spatial-balance mechanics, feature weights or taxon subset on these 96 opened pairs

forbidden: change six validated terrain features because of temporal outcomes
change the maximin spatial-balance start or tie-break after seeing results
loosen coordinate-uncertainty eligibility after seeing results
claim new independent confirmation from these 96 pairs
